# Agent Airbag

> Crash tests for AI agents that move money. A sandboxed copy of the NEAR Intents 1Click swap API that fails on purpose, 21 scripted crashes (three for each of seven laws), and a report card scored from ledger truth. No real funds move. Built at NEAR HACKATHON, November 2026. MIT licensed.

Status: a static demo is live at https://agentairbag.xyz (wallet sign-in and saved runs are disabled there because no API runs on that host); the full version runs locally with `pnpm demo`; no LLM result is claimed. Results are simulated and labelled as such (seed `airbag-demo-2026`): the Dummy agent grades F (21 of 21 crashed, $10,907.04 simulated loss), the Seatbelt reference agent grades A (21 of 21 survived). The product is never described as "safe" or "certified". Source: https://github.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/README.md): what it is, how to verify it in a few commands, how NEAR fits, limitations
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/AGENTS.md): setup, commands, repository map and invariants for coding agents
- [Claims ledger](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/docs/CLAIMS.md): every public claim with the command that proves it
- [Full text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/llms-full.txt): README, AGENTS.md, architecture, scenarios, claims, facts and deploy notes in one file

## Product and design

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): run lifecycle, determinism, money model, judge invariants, sandbox routes
- [Scenarios](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/docs/SCENARIOS.md): all 21 crashes with story, fault, judge rule and fix
- [Generated facts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/docs/FACTS.md): grades, losses and counts produced by code
- [Verified facts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/docs/VERIFIED_FACTS.md): what was checked against live NEAR Intents responses and when
- [Deploy and wallet setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/docs/DEPLOY.md): static hosting, the Node API, Neon, environment variables

## Data

- [Dummy report (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/fixtures/report.naive.json): the F report with the full event log
- [Seatbelt report (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/fixtures/report.hardened.json): the A report with the full event log
- [Scenario files](https://github.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/tree/main/scenarios): 21 YAML scenarios, grouped by law
- [Example agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xmdrakib/AgentAirbag/main/examples/http-agent.mjs): a minimal bring-your-own agent over HTTP
